label: Ping (active health probe)
type: an active, side-effecting SDK health check that queries live services for status/latency across every reachable node - contrasted with the passive sdk:diagnostics
note: Cross-product namespace fork, resolved: python-sdk/concept-docs/health-check.json independently minted 'sdk:ping-check' for the identical mechanism ('Ping actively queries the status of the specified services, giving status and latency information for every node reachable' - verbatim-equivalent to java-sdk/howtos/health-check.json's '`Ping` _actively_ queries the status of the specified services, giving status and latency information for every node reachable'). Filed under the shorter Java spelling, matching the SDK's own method name (ping()); see aliases.
